title: Open Source Enterprise Sales / Alliances - Colombia (Spanish Speaker)
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job Overview

Join to apply for the Open Source Enterprise Sales / Alliances - Colombia (Spanish Speaker) role at Canonical . While this link is looking in particular for a Spanish Speaker to work on the Colombian territory, this is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales and Alliances teams. Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

About Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Roles

As we continue to grow we are looking to hire both Enterprise Sales and Alliances Sales representatives to drive revenue growth and meet our goals. Our Alliances Sales Directors own a book of business helping to enable Canonical to work with its go to market partners, hardware vendors, software vendors, solutions integrators and distributors and channels. With a fast growing channel business, GSI/SI and Hardware partners, we need to enable, manage and grow business opportunities and drive market expansion alongside revenue growth. Reporting to the Alliances leadership, you will be working with direct sales, marketing, product, customer success, finance, legal and support as you demonstrate thought leadership, practical skills, and apply your knowledge and experience to help us grow in this critical area. Our Enterprise Sales Executives own the relationships with our direct customers and are responsible for maintaining and growing relationships that result in mutually beneficial engagements. They help craft solutions that enable our customers to be more efficient, solve more complex problems and walk the path with the customer to get the best possible results. Reporting to Sales leadership, you will work across either a region or a vertical and you can bring your knowledge of previous customers with you. We are committed to giving customers the most knowledgeable and most competent partners in sales so that we can succeed together.

Location

Location: We have remote opportunities available globally. This link in particular is for a Spanish Speaker based in or able to easily commute to Colombia. A good knowledge of the Colombian market is mandatory.

These roles entail
  • Advancing a deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models
  • Experience with negotiating contracts and commercial business terms
  • Building and expanding strategic relationships
  • Building and owning the strategy and the development of the sales engagements
  • Growing customers awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Delivering on targets, objectives and providing a voice of the partner and/or customer
  • Travelling both domestically and internationally to drive partnerships in person
  • Aligning and supporting internal Field teams to identify, support, grow and transact
  • Working closely with Marketing, Sales Engineering and Product Management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner and/or customer
  • Leading executive interlocks between partners/customers and our own leadership team
What we are looking for in you
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve revenue outstanding results in our technological field
  • Experience with Linux and opensource
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, regardless of seniority of current position
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation with results orientated mind set and a high level of personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long and more regularly to meet clients and partners as required
What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program including Health and Wellness platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

description:
Overview

Role: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging) at Canonical. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

What we are looking for in you
  • You have expertise in Python.
  • You have a strong understanding of the makeup of a modern GNU/Linux distribution.
  • You have a good understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation.
  • Experience working with container technology, such as Docker, Kubernetes and LXD.
  • Use your familiarity with languages, toolchains, frameworks, integrations, and CI systems to extend the snap build ecosystem
  • Work with external open source and commercial projects to understand how we can better serve community needs.

title: Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction
description:
Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Software Engineer - L3 Support role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Software Engineer - L3 Support role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer - L3 Support to…

…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.

This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.

You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Coordenador de Desenvolvimento Galênico (Medicamentos Novos)

Da Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento & Inovação (PDI)

Se você é apaixonado por pesquisar e desenvolver medicamentos e novas opções terapêuticas, movido por desafios, melhorias e tendências de mercado, comprometido com os resultados e tem brilho nos olhos ao atuar com inovações, essa oportunidade é para você! #Vem Ser FQM

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua há 93 anos no Brasil (desde 1932), faz parte do Grupo Roemmers, multinacional com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina. No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos, cosméticos atua em 02 segmentos: Medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história através de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

Descrição sumarizada: Coordenar o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, conduzindo pesquisas e projetos, desenvolvendo fórmulas, demandando a compra de materiais produtivos, validando lotes piloto, elaborando dossiês e realizando a transferência de tecnologia para a área de produção, com o objetivo de ampliar o portfólio de produtos da FQM, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução do nosso portfólio e excelência dos nossos medicamentos.

Local de atuação: Planta Fabril Rio de Janeiro – Rua Viúva Cláudio, 300 – Jacaré, RJ

Principais Atividades

  • Coordenar a captação de informações e ideias da sua equipe de desenvolvimento, definindo indicadores que orientem a criação de projetos alinhados aos valores e objetivos da FQM.
  • Direcionar as propostas de pesquisa e formulação de novos produtos, garantindo coerência científica e viabilidade técnica desde o início.
  • Coordenar pesquisas relativas aos produtos em avaliação, com o objetivo de levantar dados e informações que sustentem o desenvolvimento da fórmula e do processo de produção adequados às moléculas trabalhadas e, com a conclusão desta etapa, designar o projeto para o pesquisador responsável.
  • Gerir e acompanhar os projetos iniciados, validando a formulação e o processo delineados.
  • Avaliar os fornecedores de insumos e/ou serviços selecionados por sua equipe, negociando condições e selecionando o que melhor se adapta ao modelo de negócio da FQM.
  • Coordenar a produção de lotes piloto em escala industrial, garantindo conformidade com as especificações e acompanhamento dos estudos de estabilidade dos novos fármacos.
  • Coordenar a elaboração dos dossiês técnicos dos produtos desenvolvidos, consolidando documentação de fórmulas e processos para o registro oficial junto aos órgãos reguladores.
  • Finalizar a etapa de desenvolvimento com a transferência completa do conhecimento técnico para o setor produtivo, viabilizando a fabricação em escala e garantindo a qualidade e eficácia dos produtos reproduzidos.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa preferencialmente em Farmácia.
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou especialização em Gestão de Projetos, áreas técnicas afins ou em Liderança/Gestão de Pessoas será um diferencial.
  • Imprescindível vivência de 5+ anos com desenvolvimento de novos medicamentos na Indústria Farmacêutica (IF);
  • Conhecimento avançado em gestão de projetos, incluindo o controle minucioso de etapas e o acompanhamento rigoroso dos prazos, com reporte estruturado ao longo de todo o ciclo.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, principalmente Excel, Power Point e MS Project;
  • Proatividade, orientação a resultados, planejamento, determinação, capacidade analítica, boa comunicação, liderança, perfil curioso e inovador, comprometimento com metas e prazos e bom relacionamento interpessoal
  • Excelente capacidade de relacionamento com os médicos, líderes de opiniões, farmacêuticos etc.
  • Gestão de equipe e reporte ao Gerente da área na estrutura organizacional
  • Disponibilidade participação em eventos e em feiras do setor (FCE, FISA, NIS, COSMETICS) além de visitas à parceiros ou empresas terceirizadas.

Partner with the best

  • Lead Finite Element Analysis (FINA) for flexible pipeline equipment and components.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation Systems
description:
Overview

Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation Systems. We are hiring to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys and contribute to engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

Responsibilities
  • Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experiences for millions of users daily.
  • Own modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation to improve personalization speed, relevance, and impact.
  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale.
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements.
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue.
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces.
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact.
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features.
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact.
  • Experience deploying ML systems serving 100M+ predictions daily.
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning).
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks.
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization.
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices.
Competencies
  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out.
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, Weights & Biases).
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement.
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features.
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies.
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them.
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor.
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization.

title: Senior Analyst, Climate Finance
description:
About CPI

Climate Policy Initiative (CPI) is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change. CPI has seven offices around the world in Brazil, India, Indonesia, South Africa, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

Climate Finance Tracking

Since 2011, CPI has published the Global Landscape of Climate Finance series which has been the global benchmark for robust information on climate finance, providing foundational data for the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change 6th Assessment Report, and the UNFCCC’s Biennial Assessment among others. CPI also develops deep dive analysis tracking climate finance flows at sectoral, national and regional levels including the intersection of climate and SDG goals, agrifood systems finance, adaptation and renewable energy working with partners such as the Global Center on Adaptation (GCA), International Development Finance Club (IDFC), the Glasgow Financial Alliance for Net Zero, Bloomberg, the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) and many more.

Our unique tracking analysis covers both public and private finance data, providing access through concise reporting and interactive data visualization. Our research provides a baseline and compelling analysis against which to measure progress. This enables us to drive informed climate finance policymaking through three key levers:

  • Flows – what investment is flowing to whom
  • Needs – what is the investment gap to deliver on climate goals
  • Impact – what is proving effective and efficient in climate finance
Position Summary

This position supports the delivery of key objectives across CPI’s strategic priorities, under the supervision and guidance of Brazil's Research Director. CPI offers a challenging environment that requires independent thinking, collaboration, and pragmatic problem solving. This Senior Analyst role will be focused within the CPI’s Climate Finance Tracking workstream, including tracking national climate finance flows, aligning finance with low-carbon and climate-resilient development, and assessing key gaps in financing climate action at regional and sectoral levels as well as managing relationships with partners and key stakeholders.

Senior Analysts undertake robust and careful analysis, drawing on methodologies from micro- and macroeconomics, public policy, regulatory economics, finance, behavioural science, risk management, statistics, law, engineering, and other disciplines. In conducting analysis, Senior Analysts work in close cooperation, often leading, a range of partners from the policy, finance, and corporate spheres, as well as with CPI teams across the globe.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities
  • Perform rigorous quantitative and qualitative evaluation of national and international climate finance mechanisms and climate and energy policies, risk management, and interactions between public and private actors and resources
  • Lead/Manage climate finance tracking projects as designated by, and under the direction of senior management, develop, manage, and implement complex research assignments and analytical projects
  • Lead the writing and editing of high-quality CPI products, including full reports, executive summaries, blogs, and presentations. Produce high-quality materials that are fit for purpose time and within budget
  • Identify opportunities to develop and consolidate work streams and lead development of funding proposals under guidance of senior management
  • Train, manage and provide guidance to junior staff on professional work practices and lead by example
  • Engage clients, advise policymakers and investors on the implications of research findings
  • Communicate and collaborate with CPI staff working around the globe
Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Essential:

  • Post-graduate or master's degree with 5-7 years in Economics, Finance, Investment or another relevant field
  • Significant professional experience in financial services, management consulting, international nonprofit, government, and/or a multilateral institution
  • Strong understanding of climate finance and the financial sector actors and actions that are needed to mobilize effective finance towards adaptation and resilience activities
  • Excellent project management skills including time management, task delegation and prioritization, and communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage and engage stakeholders in the financial sector
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English

Beneficial:

  • Significant experience in research and analysis related to climate/green finance; experience across the public and private sectors in climate/green investments, taxonomies, net zero finance
  • Advanced user of MS Office, particularly Excel; knowledge of SQL, R, Python is a plus
  • Sector-specific or multi-sector climate finance expertise
  • Willingness to travel

Personal Attributes:

  • Independent, analytical mind with an excellent track record of applying sound financial, political, and strategic judgment to complex issues
  • Proven leadership skills, willingness and ambition to take initiative
  • Strong commitment to topics related to climate change and a desire to make a difference
  • Flexibility, professionalism, enthusiasm for team work, and ability to interact with diverse people; strong attention to detail, organization, time management, prioritization, and ability to work under pressure and tight deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills
Position details

CPI is recruiting for a full-time position in our Rio de Janeiro office. CPI in Brazil hires through the Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio) with a “CLT” contract. CPI has adopted a hybrid working policy whereby staff mix remote work with 2 regular days in the Rio de Janeiro office in Gávea.

CPI offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes 20 days leave, office closure between Christmas and New Year, 5 days study leave, USD 500 professional development budget and possibility to enrol on PUC’s courses.

Salaries are based on experience and market.

To apply

To apply, please submit a current resume and answer all the following questions in English, by October 5th. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Please add to your contact list to ensure delivery of all correspondence from us.

CPI Commitment

Climate Policy Initiative is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion and we are working to embed DEI across every facet of our organisation. We seek to establish a working environment where all board members, staff, volunteers, and contractors feel respected and valued regardless of gender, age, race, ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation or identity, disability, education, or any other bias. We want to create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity are openly valued as critical to the success of our organization and the achievement of our mission and vision.

If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application. We will then work with you to identify the best way to assist you through the recruitment process.

  7. description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição no Rio de Janeiro, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O/a Gerente de Projeto atuará como responsável pela gestão do ciclo relativo à execução de projeto no Rio de Janeiro, com uma abordagem integrada relativa aos aspectos ligados a implementação e administração. Sua principal função é desenvolver o projeto de acordo com o tempo, prazo, escopo e conteúdo estabelecido junto com Cliente administrando equipe e recurso para tal escopo. title: Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems
description:
Overview

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization.

We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

You’ve shipped large-scale ML systems into production that power personalization at scale. You’re fluent in ranking algorithms and know how to turn data into engagement and conversions. Specifically:

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices
YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES
  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability
COMPETENCIES
  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

  • Expertise building ML systems with deep expertise in large-scale personalization
  • Recognized industry expertise through patents, publications, or significant product impact
  • Proven success architecting ML platforms serving billions of predictions in production
  • Demonstrated track record of 0→1 innovation in personalization or recommender systems
  • Mastery across multiple ML domains including deep learning, causal inference, multi-armed bandits, and graph-based models

EXPERIENCE: 10+ years designing, developing, and deploying large-scale machine learning systems with a focus on personalization

YOUR ROLE Establish the technical vision for personalization at Launch Potato, solving the company’s most complex ML challenges and influencing strategy, architecture, and innovation across teams.

  • Solve critical technical challenges such as cold start, real-time learning, and exploration/exploitation tradeoffs
  • Design and implement advanced ML solutions using cutting-edge techniques (e.g., graph neural networks, causal models, bandit algorithms)
  • Create and enforce ML architecture patterns, design standards, and reusable infrastructure across teams
  • Lead multi-quarter, cross-functional initiatives that redefine how personalization impacts business KPIs
  • Act as technical mentor to senior ML engineers, guiding complex decision-making and scaling team capability
  • Represent Launch Potato’s technical brand externally through speaking engagements, open source contributions, or publications
  • Champion privacy-preserving personalization, responsible AI practices, and adaptive learning systems

COMPETENCIES

  • Visionary Thinking: Defines the future state of ML infrastructure and personalization strategy. Balances deep technical rigor with a strong understanding of product impact.

  • Technical Influence: Drives decision-making and builds consensus across teams and stakeholders without direct authority. Provides trusted guidance in ambiguous situations.
  • Expert-Level Execution: Navigates deep technical complexity while maintaining execution velocity. Translates research insights into production-ready solutions.

title: Projetista de Tubulação III
description:
Sobre a vaga:

O Projetista de Tubulação será responsável pela modelagem, detalhamento e desenvolvimento de projetos de sistemas de tubulação aplicados a embarcações, plataformas e estruturas offshore. Esse profissional terá papel essencial na elaboração de desenhos técnicos, isométricos e listas de materiais, assegurando que todas as soluções estejam alinhadas com os requisitos técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios da indústria naval e offshore.

Rotina de trabalho:

Trabalhar na Proper Marine é integrar uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada, com foco em excelência técnica, inovação e segurança. Nosso ambiente estimula a troca de conhecimento, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a entrega de soluções eficientes, com espaço para autonomia, criatividade e crescimento profissional.

Formação e experiência:

  • Curso Técnico completo em Projetos Mecânicos, Tubulação, Mecânica, Engenharia Naval ou áreas afins.

  • Desejável formação complementar em Engenharia ou cursos de especialização em tubulação industrial/naval.

  • Registro no CREA (para técnicos ou tecnólogos).

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos atuando como projetista de tubulação em ambientes navais, offshore ou óleo & gás.

  • Vivência com projetos de sistemas complexos de tubulação a bordo de FPSOs, embarcações de apoio marítimo, sondas, plataformas fixas ou módulos industriais.

Principais responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver e revisar modelos 3D de tubulação usando ferramentas específicas (AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks).

  • Elaborar isométricos, desenhos ortogonais, layouts e listas de materiais (BOM/MTO).

  • Realizar roteamento de linhas considerando espaço, interferências, suporte, manutenção e acessibilidade.

  • Participar de revisões de projeto (model review) com equipes multidisciplinares, propondo soluções de engenharia.

  • Garantir que os desenhos estejam em conformidade com os P&IDs, normas de classe e diretrizes do projeto.

  • Verificar interferências e colisões (clash detection) junto às disciplinas de estrutura, elétrica e instrumentação.

  • Preparar documentação técnica de apoio à fabricação e montagem.

  • Colaborar com engenheiros e coordenadores de projeto na definição de especificações e padrões técnicos.

  • Apoiar na compatibilização de disciplinas e interface com fornecedores e estaleiros quando necessário.

Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Domínio em ferramentas de modelagem e detalhamento de tubulação:

  • AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks, SmartPlant ou equivalentes.

  • Leitura e interpretação de diagramas de processo (P&ID), fluxogramas, plantas e cortes.

  • Conhecimento em:

  • Materiais e classes de tubulação (carbono, inox, duplex, cobre-níquel etc.)

  • Componentes de sistemas de tubulação: válvulas, flanges, suportes, juntas de expansão, etc.

  • Normas e códigos aplicáveis: ASME B31.3 / B31.1, API, NORSOK, ISO, NR-13, entre outros.

  • Noções de cálculo de suportação e esforço, embora não seja um cargo de engenharia.

  • Experiência com sistemas típicos de embarcações e offshore, como:

  • Sistemas de lastro, incêndio, ar-condicionado, combustível, ar comprimido, água potável e esgoto.

  • Familiaridade com práticas de projeto naval, requisitos de classe (DNV, ABS, BV).

  • Inglês técnico para leitura de normas, especificações e comunicação com equipes globais.

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Atenção aos detalhes: compromisso com qualidade, precisão e conformidade técnica.

  • Organização: capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos entregáveis com eficiência.

  • Comunicação clara: para dialogar com equipes internas, engenheiros, fornecedores e estaleiros.

  • Trabalho em equipe: colaboração ativa com diferentes disciplinas.

  • Proatividade: iniciativa para propor melhorias técnicas e identificar possíveis inconsistências de projeto.

  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade: agilidade para lidar com alterações de escopo e prazos apertados.

  • Comprometimento com prazos e excelência técnica.

Se você tem experiência sólida em projetos de tubulação naval e quer atuar em uma empresa global com foco em engenharia de ponta, segurança e inovação, essa vaga é para você!

title: Center Director, PANAFTOSA
description:
Overview

Grade: P-5

Salary - Annually: Step I - 101,540.00 USD

Post Adjustment - Annually: 30,563.54 USD

Contractual Agreement: Staff - Professional Post

Job Posting: September 4, 2025

Closing Date: September 25, 2025, 11:59 PM Brasilia Standard Time

Primary Location: Rio De Janeiro, Brazil

Organization: AFT Centro Panamericano de Fiebre Aftosa (PANAFTOSA)

Schedule: Full time

Description of Duties / Organizational Context

The incumbent is responsible for the management of the Pan American Foot-and-Mouth Disease Center and Veterinary Public Health (PANAFTOSA), providing leadership on the principles and implementation of PAHO’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health and One Health. The incumbent promotes the applications of One Health good practices and is responsible for the management and administration of the Center’s human and financial resources and fixed assets. He/she must maintain a harmonious and effective collaboration with counterparts in national and international administrations, and non-government, philanthropic, academic and private organizations, from the public health, agriculture and animal health sectors. The incumbent should cultivate and maintain a close professional relationship with Brazilian Authorities, particularly those related to the operation and maintenance of the Center, in accordance with the Agreement signed by the Government of Brazil with PAHO for the Center. The incumbent follows broadly stated guidance in terms of policy and mission of the Organization and has the authority to establish guidelines of major importance on programmatic activities and Center’s management and administration operations to address problems that might require complex considerations and alternative possible solutions, involving internal and external stakeholders. The incumbent acts as prime advisor of the Organization to discuss problems and seek solutions on VPH and One Health policy issues in direct coordination with the Assistant Director in the area of One Health. The incumbent will be responsible for the VPH and One Health component of the PAHO Strategic Plan and Biennial Work Plans, within the framework of the policy orientations and mandates of the Governing Bodies.

Summary of Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Director, Communicable Diseases and Environmental Determinants of Health (CDE) and the general supervision of the Assistant Director (AD), the incumbent is responsible for the following duties:

  • Lead the Organization’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health (VPH) for the elimination of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), food safety and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the food of animal origin value chain, and the prevention, control/elimination of zoonotic and foodborne diseases and envenomation in the Americas, consistent with the One Health approach.
  • Direct, manage, plan, organize, implement and evaluate programs necessary to achieve the aims and objectives of the Center’s technical cooperation, including field interventions, research, training and dissemination of information.
  • Provide technical expertise and lead the normative function of the Organization regarding food safety and control/elimination of FMD and zoonotic diseases in collaboration with partners, academia, ministries of health, ministries of agriculture, and other stakeholders.
  • Advise and promote inter-programmatic work across the Organization to ensure efficient use of resources and alignment with biennium work plans and strategic priorities.
  • Lead and direct the management and administration of the Center, ensuring alignment with the Strategic Plan, Biennial Work Plans, UNDSS security requirements, and business continuity planning.
  • Direct and guide technical cooperation for strengthening national and international disease information and surveillance systems on FMD, and foodborne and zoonotic diseases.
  • Direct technical cooperation for strengthening national laboratories and international laboratory networks, including training programs and coordinating reference services.
  • Oversee the Organization’s WOAH Reference Laboratory on FMD and WOAH Collaborating Center on Veterinary Public Health.
  • Mobilize human and financial resources in support of national programs and cooperate with member states in designing and evaluating project proposals.
  • Serve as the Secretary of COSALFA and REDIPRA, including planning and managing meetings and presenting at international events.
  • Provide leadership to staff in a multicultural environment, mentor supervised staff, set objectives, conduct performance reviews, and promote staff development.
  • Promote ethical behavior and integrity in line with PAHO’s Code of Ethical Principles and Conduct.
  • Provide a stable managerial framework and advise Member States’ institutions in the area of expertise.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.
Key Behavioral Competencies

Overall attitude at work: Maintains integrity, ethical approach, and accountability; respects colleagues and counterparts.

Respecting and valuing individual differences: Treats everyone with dignity and respect; avoids stereotypes; considers others’ perspectives.

Teamwork: Fosters collaboration across the Organization, builds partnerships, and maintains an effective network.

Communication: Articulates strategic objectives, adapts to audiences, and shares knowledge and directives effectively.

Creating an empowering and motivating environment: Provides direction, motivates teams, and promotes autonomy and high performance.

Ensuring effective use of resources: Sets measurable objectives, allocates resources, and monitors progress.

Driving the Organization to a successful future: Leads with vision, fosters a culture of long-term goals, and rewards progress.

Technical Expertise
  • Technical: Extensive senior experience in managing complex human/animal health programs at national and international levels; strong knowledge of public and animal health, veterinary public health, surveillance, and evidence-based advisory capabilities.
  • Managerial: Senior management experience in large administrations; proficiency in health administration, international legislation, negotiation, and organizational development.
  • Administrative: Resource mobilization, financial management, and administration platforms for Finance, Budget, HR, and Infrastructure; ability to handle confidential information.
Education (Qualifications)

Essential: University degree in veterinary medical science, and a master’s degree in public health, veterinary public health, animal health, veterinary epidemiology, or related field from an accredited institution.

Desirable: Doctoral degree in a public health or animal health-related area.

Experience

Essential: Thirteen years of progressively increased responsibilities in national and international management, with experience designing, planning, executing, and evaluating technical cooperation related to public and animal health; involvement in international technical cooperation programs and activities in veterinary public health and One Health; experience with FMD, food safety, zoonoses, and epidemiological surveillance at the international level.

Languages

Very good knowledge of English and Spanish with a working knowledge of another language. Knowledge of Portuguese and/or French would be an asset.

IT Skills

Demonstrated ability to use current technology and software, ERP and management information systems; proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, OneDrive, PowerPoint, Teams, Visio, SharePoint and Project is an asset.

title: Executive Tournament Director
description:
Executive Tournament Director

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the biggest female sporting event in the world, the pinnacle of women’s football globally and the main showcase for our sport, our athletes, our Member Associations, and our fans. FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

THE POSITION

The Executive Tournament Director, under the guidance of FIFA’s Chief Women’s Football Officer will be responsible for leading the team in Brazil tasked with the successful delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. The Executive Tournament Director will represent FIFA in Brazil as the primary lead on all tournament related matters in close consultation and collaboration with the CBF, the Brazilian Government, State Governments, local authorities and the Brazilian Football stakeholders. In particular, the Tournament Director will ensure that the strategy, objectives and operational milestones for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 are achieved in a timely manner, within the agreed budgets and in accordance with all FIFA and Brazilian laws, rules and regulations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • The Executive Tournament Director will be directly responsible for all administrative, commercial, financial, legal, communication and reporting matters related to the tournament guided by and in close collaboration with the relevant FIFA Chief Officers and the Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will oversee and support the work of the Executive Operations Director to ensure that all operational milestones are delivered to a high standard, within agreed timeframes and within targeted financial parameters.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will also serve as a key representative and spokesperson for the event in Brazil, effectively engaging with stakeholders, participants, and media to promote its mission and values in close collaboration with the Chief Women’s Football Officer and Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will form part of the FWWC2027 Senior Leadership Team together with the FIFA Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup and the FIFA27 Executive Operations Director.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will be responsible for ensuring effective delivery from all Departments and key functional areas involved in the tournament delivery in close collaboration with the Executive Operations Director.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will be responsible for ensuring seamless collaboration and reporting into the FIFA Leadership.
YOUR PROFILE
  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience in leading roles in sports event management and delivery.
  • Proven track record in international event delivery with clear achievement of KPIs on budget, event objectives and operational milestones.
  • Experience in working with the Brazilian Federal and State Governments.
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Clear experience in managing multi-million-dollar event budgets.
  • Experience in managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas.
  • Ability to effectively monitor employees’ organisational performance and implement decisive corrective actions.
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain highly qualified employees.
  • Have the following strengths: high energy levels, entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Competent IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes (project management certification such as PRINCE2 or PMP an advantage).
  • Experience and knowledge of the local culture and political structures in Brazil.
  • Experience of working in football is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women\u2019s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\u2019s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Training Site Infrastructure Manager
description:
Training Site Infrastructure Manager

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Training Site Infrastructure Manager reports to the FWWC27 Head of Infrastructure and Technical Services and FIFA Training Sites Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Tournament Infrastructure team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA\'s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

This position plays a pivotal role in the planning, development, and delivery of infrastructure at FIFA Women\'s World Cup 2027 training sites across Brazil. Working alongside the FIFA Training Site Manager and in coordination with Team Services, Technical Services, Pitch Management, Venue Design, Dressing & Signage, Media Operations, Partnerships and external stakeholders (Training Site Authorities and Football Clubs), the role is responsible for ensuring all training sites are operationally ready and compliant with FIFA’s requirements and standards.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in architectural and interior design, technical project management, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale international event delivery. As demonstrated through global events such as FIFA World Cups and Olympic Games. They will manage the implementation of training site upgrades, including renovations, overlays, and delivery of essential infrastructure, with a focus on strategic planning, design integration, and resource optimization.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead the design and infrastructure delivery strategy for all FWWC2027 training sites, incorporating best practices in venue planning, design management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinate the implementation of renovations and upgrades, overseeing construction quality, progress, and alignment with FIFA’s requirements and standards.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of overlay and technical service delivery, including scope definition, scheduling, procurement, installation, and handover.
  • Engage with Training Site Authorities, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Implement project controls for budgeting, reporting, and risk mitigation.
  • Ensure sustainability, cultural alignment, and aesthetic quality across all training site environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Pitch Management, Cleaning & Waste, Venue Design, and Dressing & Signage to ensure cohesive delivery.
YOUR PROFILE
  • 10+ years of experience in architectural design, project management, and delivery of international sporting event infrastructure.
  • Proven track record in managing venue delivery and readiness, overlay operations, or major venue infrastructure for events like FIFA World Cup or Olympics.
  • Strong technical expertise in space planning, stakeholder communication, and procurement processes.
  • Bachelor\'s or Master’s Degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women\'s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\'s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides general purpose short-term real estate collateralized commercial loans to a broad customer base comprised of small and medium sized businesses throughout the United States that lack access to traditional funding.

This is a Contract/Consultant position. Generally, working hours will be 9:00am-6:00pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, although hours worked may be greater based upon operational requirements.

Collaborate with Medical Affairs and Commercial teams for scientific accuracy and strategic alignment

Identify, engage, and nurture key opinion leaders (KOLs), rising stars, and regional champions. title: Billing Coordinator
description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

Role Description

The Billing Coordinator will lead our Billing Team in delivering exceptional invoicing experiences to our valued clients in the Americas Region. In this role, you will supervise, develop, motivate, and mentor the Billing Team to ensure that all invoicing is carried out punctually, comprehensively, and with precision. Collaboration with various functions within Airswift, including Operations, Accounting, and Accounts Receivables, is crucial. The Billing Coordinator will manage a high volume of invoicing, resolve escalated issues, and cultivate an environment that places significant emphasis on customer service and efficiency. Adaptability and quick learning are key attributes for success in this role.

Principle Accountabilities
  • Streamline and oversee the billing process across multiple contract types.
  • Responsible for implementing and documenting regional policies and procedures while ensuring adherence to applicable group policies and procedures.
  • Provide hands-on training and collaborate with operations to identify and implement process improvements.
  • Plan and execute quality assurance initiatives for all processes.
  • Ensure that team productivity, compliance, and quality standards are consistently met.
  • Identify problems, propose alternatives, recommend solutions, and implement approved solutions.
  • Collaborate with the collections team to research and resolve billing issues or discrepancies, working closely with the sales and operations departments to ensure accuracy and contract compliance of disputed items.
Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
  • Bachelor's degree (BA or BS) in Accounting or Finance, or an equivalent level of knowledge in a relevant field.
  • Fluent English.
  • Mandatory minimum of 8 years of experience in progressive accounts receivable/billing roles, preferably in the staffing industry.
  • Mandatory minimum of 5 years of people management experience, including direct employees and via Leads/Supervisors.
  • Brazilian billing process (local taxes) strong knowledge is required.
  • Preferred experience with third-party payer guidelines, billing practices, and reimbursement practices.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to effectively manage and mentor staff.
  • Capability to work independently and within a team environment.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Analytical skills to evaluate situations, present conclusions, and recommend action plans.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluency in English is required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
What we can offer you!
  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.
Our Core Values
  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

title: Engenheiro de Planejamento
description:
Resumo da Vaga

Archer está em busca de um(a)Engenheiro(a) de Planejamento para integrar nosso time e contribuir com excelência na gestão de projetos e operações offshore.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Garantir cumprimento e aderências das normas regulamentadoras e legislativas.
  • Auxiliar os Engenheiros de Manutenção no desenvolvimento e gerenciamento dos escopos de parada de manutenção.
  • Monitorar constantemente o status das PO's (Purchase Orders/ Ordens de Compra) e verificar com os fornecedores.
  • Participar de reuniões, conforme necessário, incluindo reuniões internas ou reuniões com o cliente, fornecedores, entidades reguladoras ou terceiros.
  • Monitorar diariamente as atividades de manutenção a bordo e estar sempre ciente da operação atual e futura para fornecer suporte conforme necessário.
  • Auxiliar o Gerente de manutenção e Engenheiros de manutenção na identificação da causa raiz das falhas/quebra dos equipamentos;
  • Auxiliar os Engenheiro de manutenção nos processos de análise de risco e postergação das atividades de manutenção preventiva e notificações levantadas a bordo.
  • Inspecionar o almoxarifado onshore a fim de garantir o bom mantenimento dos equipamentos e garantir a integridade dos mesmos.
  • Controlar o reparo e devolução de equipamentos e alinhar com a estratégia de reparo de equipamentos com o Engenheiro de Manutenção e Gerente de Manutenção.
  • Controlar a conservação de peças sobressalentes e manter contato constante com o fornecedor para garantir que o equipamento esteja pronto para operação.
  • Acompanhar o desembarque de todos os equipamentos para inspeção e reparo até que retorne à plataforma e fornecer atualizações semanais ao Gerente de Manutenção.
  • Gerenciar o envio de equipamento para revisão e verificar se está em boas condições e acompanhado por instruções claras do que deve ser feito.
  • Auxiliar o Engenheiro de Manutenção a alocar os recursos offshore de forma adequada para atender integralmente o plano de manutenção e cumprir as metas de manutenção preditiva e preventiva.
  • Manter controle de serviço e terceiros atualizado para controle de orçamento.
  • Auxiliar o desenvolvimento e gerenciamento de escopos de trabalho da plataforma em manutenção e agilizar os serviços necessários.
  • Realizar e controlar estoque de equipamentos e peças de reposição.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o departamento de Compras garantindo que todas as solicitações de cotações de serviços ou materiais acompanhem um escopo de serviço ou fornecimento claramente definido.
  • Preparar e distribuir relatórios de progresso periódicos sobre os serviços e/ou atividades desenvolvidas para o projeto, bem como o sistema de Manutenção e Compras.
  • Responsável pelos sistemas de manutenção ERP.
  • Auxiliar e apoiar os Supervisores de Manutenção offshore, assim como equipe de Manutenção e Compras onshore com problemas e solicitações ERP.
  • Gerenciar a logística utilizando o sistema relevante de acordo com os requisitos do Cliente/Empresa.
  • Inspecionar as instalações do almoxarifado onshore para garantir que sejam mantidas em condições adequadas para manter a integridade do estoque alocado quando necessário.
  • Realizar visita periódica a fornecedores para auditoria e garantir a qualidade do serviço.
  • Atuar como parte da equipe de suporte (on-call), incluindo as responsabilidades quando solicitado.
  • Realizar qualquer relatório e tarefas razoáveis conforme solicitado pelo Gerente de Manutenção.
Qualificação
  • Graduação em Engenharia (com CREA).
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado será considerado um diferencial.
Experiência
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Manutenção.
  • Leitura de desenhos técnicos.
  • Bons conhecimentos de informática.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas SAP.
  • Desejável conhecimento de perfuração.

description:
*** A PRESENTE OPORTUNIDADE É ESTENDIDA A PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA (PCD) E QUE ATENDAM AOS REQUISITOS DA VAGA. ***

  4. Conduzir um quarto de serviço de navegação seguro, utilizando os equipamentos disponíveis e informando ao Comandante sobre qualquer anormalidade que possa afetar a segurança da navegação;
  5. Certificar-se de que todas as informações relevantes foram mencionadas durante a passagem de serviço de quarto;
  6. Acompanhar não conformidades dentro do sistema de gestão;
  7. Monitorar atividades a bordo, garantindo o cumprimento da política de segurança do grupo;
  8. Na ausência ou impedimento do Técnico de Segurança a bordo, garantir que as ferramentas de segurança sejam realizadas, tais como Permissão de Trabalho, Tool Box Talk, APR, etc. Para isto, solicitar auxílio ao Imediato / Comandante sempre que necessário;
  9. Escriturar Diário de Navegação, Livro de Azimutes e demais exigidos pelas normas vigentes;
  10. Planejar uma travessia e determinar a posição da embarcação;
  11. Auxiliar nas manobras da embarcação, quando solicitado pelo Comandante;
  12. Ter sob sua responsabilidade todos os equipamentos de sinalização de emergência, como bandeiras, artefatos pirotécnicos, lâmpadas, lanternas e outros, além dos equipamentos de navegação;
  13. Identificar e responder a sinais de perigo, comunicando imediatamente ao Comandante;
  14. Ter sob sua responsabilidade inventariado, distribuição de acordo com o plano de emergência e manutenção de todos os equipamentos de segurança e salvatagem;
  15. Manter-se informado sobre novas regras e regulamentos que regem sua atividade;
  16. Manter atualizadas todas as cartas e publicações náuticas;
  17. Manter-se informado sobre os termos contratuais e sistema de contingência do cliente;
  18. Manter a organização do passadiço;
  19. Fazer registros de tripulantes e passageiros na embarcação, bem como manter atualizadas as listas de pessoal a bordo;
  20. Controlar os consumíveis do passadiço e segurança e salvatagem e solicitar, através do Imediato, serviços de reparo, reposição ou substituição de peças ou equipamentos;
  21. Apresentar a embarcação a novos tripulantes, passageiros ou visitantes, realizando familiarização de segurança;
  22. Adestrar praticantes e estagiários de náutica a bordo;
  23. Preparar documentação para liberação nos portos;
  24. Familiarizar-se com o controle de acesso nos diferentes níveis de proteção, auxiliando o Oficial de Segurança na vigilância nos portos;
  25. Monitorar carga e descarga, estivagem e cuidados com o material no convés durante a navegação;
  26. Quando designado, operar o sistema de posicionamento dinâmico da embarcação, mantendo vigilância da posição e realizando manobras;
  27. Gerenciar o estágio inicial de uma falha do posicionamento dinâmico e auxiliar o Comandante em situação de emergência;
  28. Monitorar diariamente as previsões do tempo, informando ao Comandante sobre avisos de mau tempo, comunicações de emergência recebidas de outras embarcações, etc.;
  29. Informar ao Imediato sobre qualquer defeito que impossibilite o serviço de radiocomunicações;
  30. Escriturar diariamente o Diário de Radiocomunicações conforme legislação vigente;
  31. Realizar e fiscalizar inspeções, manutenções preventivas e corretivas de acordo com o programa de manutenção, conforme requisitado pelo Imediato;
  32. Auxiliar no controle da validade dos certificados dos equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade;
  33. Assistir às inspeções, vistorias e serviços de manutenção por subcontratados nos equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade;
  34. Implementar ações e procedimentos para atender ao plano de prevenção e combate à poluição adotado a bordo;
  35. Checar se seu "Certificado de Saúde de Marítimo" está válido e certificar-se de que sua renovação seja feita antes de seu vencimento;
  36. Participar das fainas integradas;
  37. Trabalhar com cuidado e técnica, utilizando os EPI necessários para o desempenho de suas atribuições com segurança e exigindo que os outros envolvidos usem;
  38. Conhecer sua função e as demais descritas na tabela mestra das fainas de emergência da embarcação;
  39. Participar das avaliações de riscos antes do início das operações.

Sua responsabilidade é desempenhar suas tarefas pontualmente e dentro dos padrões de qualidade da companhia.

  • Formação superior em Bacharel em Ciências Náuticas e/ou Agradável em curso de formação de oficiais da marinha mercante. STCW II/1
  • Competência sempre de acordo com o STCW- 2ON
  • Certificado Full DP;
  • Certificados: EROG, EARP, TBS-1, EOPN, ECIA, ESPM, ESCM, EPOL e EGPO
  • Experiência como Oficial de Quarto de Convés em embarcações com planta de ROV.
  • Inglês avançado;
